messages:
sarah: escalating — AcmeCorp reports p99 latency jump on /v1/generate after we onboarded elysium-v2. They say it started ~10:12 UTC and impacts long-context jobs (~>12k tokens). Roughly 3-5x p99 increase, intermittent 502s.

ajay: thanks, any request ids or sample payloads? are they using embeddings or chat/generation?

sarah: generation + chat completions with long system/messages. sample request id: req_0a1b2c3d from their logs. attaching repro curl from them: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model":"elysium-v2","input":"<~13k tokens payload>","max_tokens":1024}'
```

lina: infra-bot shows elysium-v2 promotion at 10:09:43 UTC via deploy-bot. Any tokenizer changes in this release?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: elysium-v2 promoted to prod at 2026-03-17T10:09:43Z (deploy id dpl_7788). Canary run passed internal perf checks (seq len up to 6k).

ajay: canary only went to 6k — we missed long-context perf. suspect tokenizer path or kvcache fragmentation. Can someone repro locally with >10k tokens?

kevin-support: I reproduced using their payload on a dedicated dev cluster (cpu emulation) — p95 ~420ms, p99 ~2.1s on elysium-v1. On elysium-v2 p95 ~1.1s, p99 ~6.8s and occasional 502s. Logs show repeated full KV cache rebuilds: 
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:10Z] kvcache: miss_count=482 ttl=0 rebuild=true seq_len=13524
[2026-03-17T10:12:11Z] tokenizer: normalize->fallback true on multibyte boundary idx=8191
[2026-03-17T10:12:11Z] http: upstream 502 on model_worker_45
```

lina: that tokenizer normalize->fallback line is interesting. elysium-v2 includes a new hybrid BPE merge plus Unicode normalization change. Could be creating huge token sequences causing more KV sharding churn.

ajay: mitigation options: 1) temporary routing rule to send long-context requests to elysium-v1; 2) patch tokenizer to avoid fallback path (fast fix); 3) increase kvcache shard size / memory on elysium-v2 workers to avoid rebuilds. Which do we want as short-term?

kevin-support: prod impact is limited to customers with >8k tokens — but a few enterprise customers (AcmeCorp) hit SLA alerts. Recommend route them to elysium-v1 and patch elysium-v2 later.

lina: agreed. I'll open a routing override: route_policy/override_longctx_el_v1 for 24h. ajay, can you add a short-term kvcache safety bump on elysium-v2 (double shard mem) to reduce 502s while we monitor?

ajay: will do. Pushing a conservative kvcache increase to cluster elysium-v2-prod now. Also creating a tokenization quick-fix branch that disables unicode-normalize fallback for sequences >8k (best-effort).

infra-bot: routing-bot: route_policy/override_longctx_el_v1 activated for customer AcmeCorp (expires in 24h).

sarah: telling AcmeCorp support team we routed them back to elysium-v1 and asked them to retry. asking for verification.

kevin-support: AcmeCorp confirms latency dropped back to baseline after routing change. No more 502s.

lina: next steps: 1) ajay finishes kvcache bump and collects heap/KV metrics; 2) engineering iterate on tokenizer quick-fix and run extended long-context perf tests to 16k+; 3) product to re-evaluate canary gating thresholds. I'll file a follow-up doc with checklist and ETA.

ajay: posted kvcache change (rollout id r_992) and started extended perf run. early numbers look 30% p99 improvement.

sarah: closing immediate escalation. leaving thread open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
